name: Gitea
description: Lightweight code hosting with issues, PRs, wiki, CI hooks. GitHub for your own hardware.
compose:
services:
  gitea:
    image: gitea/gitea:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:3000"
      - "${{cfg.ssh_port}}:22"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
    environment:
      USER_UID: "1000"
      USER_GID: "1000"
    restart: unless-stopped
